name: npm
review: Loads project and user registry configuration for package-manager operations. Bundled node_modules are excluded by the scanner.

name: @npmcli/config
review: Reads and parses a selected npm configuration file. This package supplies configuration rather than an upload implementation.

name: npm-registry-fetch
review: Selects registry credentials for the request URI and builds authentication headers. Credential transmission can be a required function.

name: registry-auth-token
review: Selects authentication information for the configured registry. Configuration-file loading is delegated to @pnpm/npm-conf, outside this package scan.

name: esbuild
review: Downloads the platform binary from npm and writes it locally during installation. Network, filesystem, and child-process use are expected.

name: playwright
review: Requests browser installation through the registry helper. This is a tooling entry point, not proof of an automatic npm lifecycle download.

name: playwright-core
review: Uses a child process to download a selected browser with progress and error handling.

name: puppeteer
review: The installation entry point requests configured browser downloads and supports skipping them. Downloads are delegated to a helper package.

name: @puppeteer/browsers
review: Implements browser download and installation. Its source also contains optional system-dependency installation commands.

name: electron
review: Downloads and extracts the selected Electron artifact with platform, version, and checksum configuration.

name: @electron/get
review: Implements artifact downloads, caching, and checksum checks. Options can change checksum behavior; the control is not an unconditional trust exemption.

name: prebuild-install
review: Downloads a configured native prebuild and can attach caller-supplied authentication. The HTTP helper itself is in a dependency outside this scan.
